purpose: Build isolated release candidates, create rollback versions and test deployments, run the controlled phone flow, repair failures through reviewed PRs, and preserve owner-controlled production approval.
definitionOfWorking: Request form calculates and shows a truthful Pulse fare before confirmation.
One confirmation creates exactly one request.
Driver can accept or decline safely.
Ride ID/PIN exposes only the correct rider-safe record.
Foreground pickup sequence remains intentional and visible.
New requests arriving during an active ride wait safely instead of interrupting the ride.
Start and Complete are intentional actions.
One completed ride creates exactly one Trip Log row.
Rollback versions, source hashes, and isolated deployment receipts are recorded.

controlledPhoneTest.participantBoundary: One known consenting adult rider and the owner-driver only.
passEvidence: Ride Requests increases by exactly one.
Calendar event count increases by exactly one after confirmation where configured.
Receipt and confirmation/access messages are each emitted once where configured.
Each approved lifecycle transition records one status event with no duplicates.
Trip Log increases by exactly one after completion.
Shift reconciliation records exactly one completed shift result or intended update.
stopConditions: Any duplicate request, status event, or Trip Log row.
Any rider privacy leak or Ride ID/PIN record mismatch.
Any skipped or impossible lifecycle transition.
Hoy Driver writes directly to Ride Requests.
Earnings reconcile falsely to zero or otherwise contradict the controlled ride.
Foreground automation advances while the app is hidden.
State becomes unrecoverable without a rollback.

sourceSnapshot.collisionPolicy: Preserve HTML basename; rename colliding SERVER_JS basename with __SERVER suffix.
